QF.id: AIFM CIII Governance and Due Diligence_22

question.text: Under SEBI (AIF) Regulations, the Sponsor and Manager of an AIF must act in which capacity towards investors?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI (AIF) Regulations explicitly state the Sponsor and Manager shall act in a FIDUCIARY capacity towards investors and shall disclose all conflicts of interest as and when they arise or seem likely to arise. The Trap: Counterparty, distributor, and nominal are all legally inferior standards and do not match the regulation. Cross-Exam Context: Same standard across XIX-C/D and applicable to XXI-B PMs. Fiduciary is the highest standard recognised in Indian securities law.
